title: A unique vision or my game
author: PlaceholderTestAcc
selftext:
Heres the gist of the lore: We play as a semi high ranking employee of Entertainment Infinity.ltc. The company behind “grand central play palace” A massive MASSIVE(twice for emphasis) facility in America thats just essentially... A Playground if it Was the size of a GODDAMN city.

We manage “mascots” Human sized Living toys Which are a hit with the kids while also managing to be murderous at the same time. its OUR job to feed them，condition them to play nice with kids，and keep them contained. 

I like poppy playtime，and ive always wondered what a game would look like playing as the employees behind a toy mascot corporation. So behold！My game！Id love to hear what you guys think！

This game is a prototype vision，in the sense what your seeing is solely me getting a gist Of what the game could look like. The actual prototype of my game would have a bigger map，more mechanics and everything！So obviously some things would look weird “why dont the floor vents match the tiles on the floor” “whys the arm weirdly overlaped” Its cause this is solely to get a gist of the game，NOT to be polished And published.
